description_en: Restarts failed trials in an hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. The system extracts the configuration of the hyperparameters of a specific trial. If none of the trials that use this configuration are successful in the experiment, the system restarts trials by using this configuration
description_zh: 重启一个HPO实验里失败的trials。对于指定的trial，提取它使用的超参配置。如果该实验所有使用这个配置的trials都没有成功过，那么用这个配置重新启动一个trial
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml restart-hpo-trials --experiment-id abcde --trial-ids xrYq99 --trial-hyper-parameters '‘_batch_size_:_32_,_lr_:_0.01' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartHpoTrials

parameters.help_en: A new hyperparameter configuration of a trial. The system starts a new trial by using this configuration
parameters.help_zh: 一个新的trial的超参配置，实验会用这组超参启动一个新trial
parameters.name: trial_hyper_parameters

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the trials that you want to restart
parameters.help_zh: 需要重新运行的、已经存在的trial ids
parameters.name: trial_ids
